item.title: Re: Axolotl
item.content:encoded:
Hey there Choysis, I'll be critting your idea today!
Note that I am neither a particularly experienced nor an offical reviewer, so take what I say with a grain of salt. With that being said, let's begin the crit!

+ Open Section-by-Section +
- Close Section-by-Section -

Elevator Pitch

So it's a celestial guardian of Earth (or rather, humanity) that lives in its own dimension, and the twist is that it's an axolotl? I'll be honest, I don't really like this idea, and as a general rule I'd advise staying away from supreme cosmic beings that defend Earth, as they're viewed as cliche by popular opinion on this Site. The axolotl part also just feels random and janky, and doesn't really fit in with the whole 'cosmic guardian' idea. In short, I think this idea is a cliche 'cosmic guardian entity', but the only flavour being that it's an axolotl for some reason (which feels random and forced).

Central Narrative

Unfortunately, your narrative isn't very impressive either, just basically a highlight reel of how the axolotl has been spotted throughout history and either stopped entities capable of K-Class scenarios1, or accidentally caused collateral damage, with minimum damage to humans. The part about the paintings and carvings makes sense however, nice catch there.

Hook/Attention Grabber

Is this idea fun or funny? I'd have to say no. It just feels kind of inane and random, assigning the role of almighty cosmic guardian to an axolotl.

+ Open General Thoughts +
- Close General Thoughts -

As a general rule, one should stay away from almighty, nigh-omnipotent beings as SCPs (very few articles get away with this. Actually, I think there's only one that does), especially ones that only exist to protect humanity from other SCPs. It just seems cliche, and, with the axolotl part, kind of random and silly.

I'd recommend three things:
1. Consider overhauling your idea (maybe making it a bit less OP and/or random) and/or story
2. Check out the Guide Hub for great advice on ideation, story writing, and more!
3. Contact reviewers from the Butterfly Squad for alternative opinions from experienced reviewers

And finally, to sum up your idea in one sentence2:
A cosmic, all-powerful axolotl that lives in its own dimension, emerging only to engage with and stop entities causing K-Class events.

Anyway, that's it for my crit today. Thanks for reading, and I hope this helps!

Footnotes
1. Being nitpicky here, but there is no way the Foundation names an anomaly, especially one capable of causing K-Class events, "Lil' Devil". This serves to break the suspension of disbelief of readers, something that articles should try their best to maintain (this is, although fictional, a scientific organisation after all).
2. This is to give you a quick idea of what critters see when they read your idea, and thus make it easier to see what you do or don't like.

item.title: Axolotl
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A massive axolotl which lives in it’s own dimension outside of space-time . It’s regenerative abilities are so advanced, it's nearly immortal. When the end of the world comes, naturally, or in the form of an “XK end of the world scenario”, the entity will appear from its dimension to fight off the opposing force.

Central Narrative: The creature was first spotted very early in the foundation’s history. Its head was first seen coming through a wormhole leading back to its home, during one of the first XK class scenario breeches, nicknamed “Lil’ Devil”. Lil’ Devil’s body radiated immense heat, which caused drastic changes to the surrounding environment.Nearly seconds before the foundation planned to launch their final attack, the axolotl lunged from its wormhole, which it had previously moved very slowly threw, snapped at Lil’ Devil, got it in one fell swoop with no damage to the surrounding area or its self, and disappeared back threw the wormhole; leaving the foundations task force stunned. Throughout the foundation’s history, the wormhole has been spotted around the world, when the possibility of the end of the world is near, but the creature hasn’t been seen coming through the wormhole since that initial spotting, except for one education, where just the tip of the axolotls poked out of the worm hole, and completely demolished a nature reserve and multiple endangered birds in the process… That all happened after the opposing force was already naturalized. Research on the creature has been challenging because of how it never leaves its wormhole, however, they have found many carvings and paintings of the axolotl all around the world, dating back thousands of years. On multiple occasions researchers found carvings of it fighting off creatures assumed to be SCP-like entities. Some researchers think the axolotl acts out of love and fondness for humanity, having shown, despite its gigantic size, to have been very precise in how it ate Lil’ Devil, making sure any drastic movements wouldn't cause harm to civilians. Recently with more XK scenarios possible, the foundation has been hard at working on trying to make contact with the creature.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I just think it’s kind of a fun and funny idea that the being which will protect Earth when the end of the world approaches, is a giant immortal axolotl, just waiting in its dimension for that time to come.
